customAttributes.name: subscription_dimensions
customAttributes.caseExpr:
case when [subscription_records.subscription_length]=1 then '1 month' 
            when [subscription_records.subscription_length]=3 then '3 month' 
            when [subscription_records.subscription_length]=12 then '12 month' else 'other' end

customAttributes.name: demographic_dimensions
customAttributes.caseExpr:
case when datediff('year', [user_records.dob], current_date()) < 25 then '18-24' 
            when datediff('year', [user_records.dob], current_date()) < 35 then '25-34' 
            when datediff('year', [user_records.dob], current_date()) < 45 then '35-44' 
            when datediff('year', [user_records.dob], current_date()) < 55 then '45-54' 
            when datediff('year', [user_records.dob], current_date()) < 65 then '55-64' else '65+' end

customAttributes.name: demographic_dimensions
customAttributes.caseExpr:
case when datediff('day', [user_records.signup_ts], current_date()) < 30 then '0-29 days' 
            when datediff('day', [user_records.signup_ts], current_date()) < 90 then '30-89 days' 
            when datediff('day', [user_records.signup_ts], current_date()) < 180 then '90-179 days'  
            when datediff('day', [user_records.signup_ts], current_date()) < 365 then '180-364 days' 
            else '365+ days' end

customMetrics.label: subscription_measures
customMetrics.formula: case when [subscription_records.subscription_type] in ('new_subscription','reactivation') then 1 else 0 end

customMetrics.label: renewal_measures
customMetrics.formula: case when [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.payment_status] in ('paid','scheduled','past_due','cancelled') then 1 else 0 end

customMetrics.label: transaction_measures
customMetrics.formula:
case when [transaction_records.transaction_type] 
              in ('new_subscription','renewal','upgrade_charge','one_time_purchase') 
            then 1 else 0 end

customMetrics.label: renewal_measures
customMetrics.formula:
case when [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.renewal_number]>1 
              and [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.payment_status] in ('paid','past_due','cancelled') 
           then 1 else 0 end

customMetrics.label: renewal_measures
customMetrics.formula:
case when [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.payment_status] in ('past_due','cancelled') 
        then 1 else 0 end

customMetrics.label: renewal_measures
customMetrics.formula:
case when [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.payment_status] in ('paid','scheduled','past_due','cancelled') 
      and [scheduled_subscription_payment_records.renewal_number]=1 then 1 else 0 end
